# Marina Wharf 1

> Marina Wharf 1 is a twenty-nine-storey residential tower on the waterfront in Dubai Marina, one of the two buildings that make up the Marina Wharf complex. It offers one-, two- and three-bedroom apartments, with shops and service outlets at ground level. Residents' facilities include a swimming pool, gymnasium, sauna, squash court and bowling alley. The tower was completed in 2010, three years after construction began.

## Project Overview

- Category: Residential / Commercial
- Location: Dubai Marina, UAE
- Status: Completed
- Year: 2010

## MENASCO Scope

Marina Wharf 1 is a 29-storey residential tower in Dubai Marina, developed by Dheeraj & East Coast as part of the two-tower Marina Wharf complex. The building offers one-, two- and three-bedroom apartments with residents' amenities. MENASCO executed the MEP works for the tower for Dheeraj & East Coast, with Dimensions Engineering Consultants as consultant.
